title: Binance Earn: Dual Investment Supports PAXG
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Terms and conditions apply.  Fellow Binancians, Binance Earn is excited to announce that  PAX Gold (PAXG)  has been added to Dual Investment from  2026-03-12 06:00 (UTC) , users can now earn additional rewards via PAXG strategy. Please see the table below for more information, including details on the additional APR rewards. Supported Token PAXG Token Pairs PAXG-USDT, PAXG-USDC Subscription Tokens PAXG, USDT or USDC Target Price Multiple Target Prices available Settlement Date 08:00 (UTC) Each Workday APR 3.65% or more PAX Gold (PAXG) is a digital asset issued by Paxos and is the largest OCC (U.S.) regulated gold-backed token. Each PAXG token is backed by one fine troy ounce (t oz) of a 400 oz London Good Delivery gold bar, securely stored in Brinks vaults. Holders of PAXG own the underlying physical gold, which is held in custody by Paxos Trust Company. Because each token represents a specific quantity of physical gold, PAXG’s value is directly tied to and tracks the market price of gold.
